Name: HUD Customizer
Author: FearGodFishFish
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/installation.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [b][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/b]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/how-to-use.png[/img]
Open the config menu with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and go to the [b]HUD Customizer[/b] category and you can set keybinds or manually toggle HUD elements.

[b]HUDs with Toggle Support[/b]
[list]
[*]Date/Time/Money Box HUD
[*]Toolbar
[*]Health & Stamina Bars
[*]Buffs HUD
[/list]
[b]HUDs with Scaling Support[/b]
[list]
[*] Toolbar
[/list]
[b]Future Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Toggles for every part of the HUD
[*] Ability to resize the HUD
[*] Ability to move HUD elements positions on screen
[*]Ability to change the color of HUD elements
[/list][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/my-other-mods.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23544]Particle Framework[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23669]Split Screen Regions[/url]
[/list]

Added scaling for Toolbar
Added config pages
